reading: Q1's M-018 holds WC-C-073 with Shopify's SH-C-039 and Salla's SA-C-060, both landed here: the admin page WooCommerce > Customers (WC-S-0042), the customers API (WC-S-0665) and the webhook topics customer.created, customer.updated and customer.deleted (WC-S-0258 to WC-S-0260). Strained: M-018 notes that WooCommerce keeps customer accounts in the same concern, and its account statements (Accounts & Privacy, WC-S-0006 and WC-S-0881; the New account and Reset password emails, WC-S-0306 and WC-S-0305; wc/v4 settings-account, WC-S-0146; guest checkout, WC-S-0928) are cited in CM-CUS-010, another tree, with Shopify's SH-C-041. Its batch endpoint (WC-S-0665) is cited in the child CM-CUS-003.

Q1's M-020 holds WC-C-103 with Shopify's SH-C-044, landed here: the Marketplace category Extensions > Merchandising > B2B (WC-S-0730) and the Purchase Order Gateway's purchase orders (WC-S-5471, WC-S-5473). Its name's wholesale and quotes have no statement held; its B2B payments are the category Extensions > Official payments > B2B payments (WC-S-0710), which Q1 placed in WC-C-005, domain C, and which is not cited here.

Q1's M-080 holds WC-C-069 with Salla's SA-C-032, landed here: WooCommerce's admin item Stock Notifications under WooCommerce > Notifications (WC-S-0047) and its email Back in stock notification (WC-S-5405), behind a feature that is experimental and off by default (WC-S-5403).

Q1's M-050 holds WC-C-074 with Salla's SA-C-070 (Coupons), landed here: WooCommerce > Coupons and Marketing > Coupons (WC-S-0048, WC-S-0062), the setting woocommerce_enable_coupons (WC-S-5409), the coupons API, a code-based object (WC-S-0664), the buyer's cart routes to apply and remove a coupon (WC-S-0151, WC-S-0157) and the coupon webhook topics. Its Analytics > Coupons statements (WC-S-0071, WC-S-0208, WC-S-0238, WC-S-0239) are left to CM-ANL, which batch 2 maps; if cited there the fit becomes strained.

Q1's M-051 holds WC-C-084 with Shopify's SH-C-129 and Salla's SA-C-075, both landed here: the admin section Marketing and Marketing > Overview (WC-S-0060, WC-S-0061, WC-S-5425) and its API group wc-admin > marketing, with overview, recommendations, channels, campaigns and campaign-types (WC-S-0186 to WC-S-0191).

Q1's M-053 holds WC-C-085 with Shopify's SH-C-131, landed here: Order Attribution, which tracks and credits channels and campaigns that contribute to orders (WC-S-0935, WC-S-0890), shown in a meta box on the order (WC-S-5426).

Joined by the terms upsell and cross-sell: the Marketplace category Extensions > Conversion > Upsells and cross-sells (WC-S-0722), Shopify's App Store category Upsell and cross-sell apps (SH-I-1846) and Salla's app category Cross/up sell (SA-S-1188); none defines it. Strained: the concern is WooCommerce's Conversion group of Marketplace categories (WC-S-0700), and its other statements are cited in other trees: Promotions (WC-S-0718) in CM-MKT-001, Recovering orders (WC-S-0719) in CM-MKT-022 (new), Rewards and loyalty (WC-S-0720) and the Points & Rewards settings page (WC-S-5479) in CM-LOY-004, and the Back In Stock Notifications extension (WC-S-5476, WC-S-5478) in CM-MKT-016. Customer feedback (WC-S-0717) and Store alerts (WC-S-0721) are uncited here (see notes).

Q1's M-051 holds WC-C-110 with WC-C-084, Shopify's SH-C-129 and Salla's SA-C-075: the Marketplace category Extensions > Marketing (WC-S-0705), the marketing apps that Shopify's and Salla's concerns keep inside. Strained: its subcategories are cited across trees: Automation (WC-S-0756) in CM-MKT-006 and Email (WC-S-0761) in CM-MKT-007, both under CM-MKT-005, but Advertising and promotions (WC-S-0755) in CM-MKT-010. CRM, Reporting and analytics, Sales channels, SEO and SEM and Social (WC-S-0757 to WC-S-0760, WC-S-0762) and Google for WooCommerce's product feed (WC-S-5492, WC-S-5494) are uncited here (see notes).

Q1's M-052 holds WC-C-113 with Shopify's SH-C-130, landed here: MailPoet – Newsletters, Email Marketing, and Automation (WC-S-0944), which WooCommerce lists among its Woo services (WC-S-0458), with its sending service (WC-S-5498, WC-S-5503). Strained: its subscriber settings for WooCommerce customers (WC-S-5500) are cited in CM-CUS-007, another tree; its automation (WC-S-0944) is also cited in CM-MKT-006, under the same parent.

A join on role, a reading: WooAds, for which the merchant authorizes access to the data from its ad platform APIs about its ad campaigns (WC-S-0947), takes the role of the store's advertising on ad platforms, by Shopify's Advertising apps (SH-S-2573) and Salla Ads (SA-S-1954). No WooAds statement held defines what the service does with that data (U-055's own doubt); the fit rests on ad campaigns on ad platforms.

Joined by the term wishlist: WooCommerce's shopper list wishlist, product_wishlist (WC-S-5456, WC-S-5457), Shopify's App Store category Wishlist apps (SH-I-1821) and Salla's Wishlist Notifications (SA-S-1761). WooCommerce's other shopper list, saved-for-later from the cart (WC-S-5458), is also products a buyer saves, so it fits the same capability. Both lists are experimental and off by default.
